correctness.rationale: The seven-variable source polynomial has a direct multiaffine nonnegativity certificate and nonnegative Fourier character coefficients, preserved by the torus homomorphism. The explicit eight-node Gram matrix has limiting signed defect -1/10. For every odd base q>=103, a coordinatewise cosine approximation and the exact sup partial derivative bound 13/35 yield |defect+1/10|<1040/q^2<1/10. On 3<=q<=23 (odd), executed outward integer interval arithmetic certifies all 88 leading principal minors strictly positive; Sylvester implies each full matrix is positive definite. For 25<=q<=101 (odd), 39 signed defects have rigorous negative upper bounds. The additional fixed strictly-positive mixture retains the same sharp cutoff by exact rational inequalities. The directly packaged CHECK.py was replayed with all assertions successful. Discrete finite verification is exhaustive because the analytic tail closes all remaining odd q.

originality.rationale: The 2011 conjecture supplies the matrix question; the complete accessible 2026 arXiv paper supplies P, its seven-dimensional counterexample, and the limiting -1/10 witness. In fact, the paper already implies qualitative circle failure by dense one-parameter restriction; no novelty is credited to that corollary. The original contribution is the complete sharp classification by odd frequency ratio q in the specific one-circle pullback, including the positive-matrix side, all negative intermediate bases, and a uniform infinite tail. No such odd-base threshold or equivalent all-base coverage was found in the inspected source full texts and actual published mathematical-record searches. This is a best-knowledge comparison, not uniqueness certification.
residual_risks: An unindexed quantitative dimension-reduction or lacunary restriction argument could give an equivalent all-odd-base cutoff; none was identified in inspected primary sources or semantic records.
The broad qualitative statement that a one-variable counterexample exists is already implied by the parent 7D construction and is not counted as original.
Novelty and scientific significance remain self-review assessments rather than independent expert certification.

value.rationale: A complete natural finite/infinite classification of the geometric lacunarity base in a specific canonical one-circle Fourier pullback is more than an isolated numerical witness. It identifies the precise first base where a strict 8x8 matrix lower bound fails, proves a strict positive zone for all earlier odd bases, precludes reentrance for every larger odd base, and persists under pointwise strict positivity. The base controls the separation of seven integer characters used to represent independent coordinates, a concrete frequency-complexity parameter useful in constructing and understanding one-variable kernel counterexamples. Its limitations relative to arbitrary frequencies or node sets are explicit.
